name: cap_polymer
display: Polymer capacitors (polymer aluminum + solid polymer electrolytic)
__comment_why__: Added 2026-07-06 for low-ESR bulk/output caps (e.g. buck converter output needing an ESR window) — the mlcc recipe can't serve that. Both LCSC polymer buckets behave identically for selection purposes, so one recipe covers them. All alias lists below come from a real raw-attrs sample of the buckets, not guesses.

category_match.subcategory: Polymer Aluminum Capacitors|Solid Polymer Electrolytic Capacitor|^Solid Capacitors$

__comment_solid__: 'Solid Capacitors' (~1.1k, added 2026-07-07) is LCSC's bucket for motherboard-style solid polymer cans — same part family, same selection criteria, so it belongs here rather than in its own recipe.
columns: __comment_esr__: the workhorse column — 287/500 sampled parts carry
'Equivalent Series Resistance(ESR)' (no space before the paren) with values
like '10mΩ@100kHz'; the parser keeps the resistance and drops the frequency
condition. Assume 100kHz spec when comparing datasheets.
__comment_ripple__: 'Rated Ripple Curren' (sic — no trailing t) is a REAL typo
in the LCSC data (11/500 parts). Keep the typo'd alias verbatim.
__comment_lifetime__: values like '2000hrs@105℃' parse to hours (2000); the
temperature condition is dropped, and it's nearly always 105℃ for polymers.
__comment_smd__: this bucket is MAJORITY through-hole (1540/2101 parts as of
2026-07-06), so this flag is essential for an SMT-assembly workflow. GROUND
TRUTH: the marker lives in the PACKAGE string and is usually CHINESE —
'插件' = plug-in/THT, alongside English 'SMD'/'Plugin' in some records; the
builder scavenges description+package for from_description flags. Filter
--where "smd = 1" for reflow-able parts; smd=0 is explicit THT; NULL =
